title: Senior/Staff Data Analyst
description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:


Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Locations Supported 🌍

  • London, UK (primary)

  • Remote (Europe)

Relocation available: Case by case

Work pattern:

  • Remote across Europe, with hybrid working encouraged if you're near a Moonbase (around 2 to 3 days per week in the London office).

About the Opportunity

In this role, you'll help shape MoonPay's product and business decisions through data, combining deep analysis, experimentation, and strong stakeholder partnership to drive real impact.

You'll sit within our centralised Product Data team and work closely with Product and Engineering, owning analytics across the full product lifecycle, from defining problems and success metrics through to launching, measuring, and optimising products at scale.

Your work will directly influence product strategy, customer experience, and business health, helping teams make better, faster decisions through trusted insights and clear narratives. You'll also raise the leverage of the whole team by building reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that let the wider org self-serve reliable answers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear direction, influencing decisions, and helping shape the future of high-impact financial and crypto products.

What You Will Do

  • Partner with product and business teams to run rigorous analysis (root cause, opportunity sizing, funnel drop-off) and turn it into clear, prioritised recommendations, moving across problem areas as priorities shift.

  • Define, document, and maintain clear metric definitions and business context, so stakeholders can understand the performance of their area and AI tools can interpret our metrics correctly (e.g. Transaction Success Rate, Fraud Rate).

  • Set up tracking and monitoring for new launches and changes, and quantify and measure their impact on KPIs.

  • Build and maintain a reporting layer, with automated alerting and root cause analysis that flags when KPIs move unexpectedly and why.

  • Design, run, and interpret experiments, from A/B tests to quasi-experimental methods like difference-in-differences when randomisation isn't possible.

  • Model robust, trusted data in our dbt and BigQuery layer, safeguarding its quality through testing, documentation, and certification in collaboration with engineering.

  • Create reusable, AI-assisted analytics skills that scale the team's impact and help Product and Engineering self-serve.

  • Communicate complex concepts and findings to technical and non-technical audiences across different teams, while ensuring clarity and understanding to drive critical business decisions.

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a data analyst or data scientist, preferably in a product-focused role.

  • Advanced SQL and data visualisation are second nature to you.

  • Hands-on experience building data models in a modern cloud warehouse and transformation framework (e.g. dbt with BigQuery, Snowflake), with a strong instinct for data quality.

  • A solid grasp of statistics and probability, including experiment design and interpretation (A/B and quasi-experimental methods such as difference-in-differences).

  • A working understanding of how a payments or fintech business operates, including fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, and payment success rates.

  • Comfort using AI-assisted and LLM tools to accelerate analysis, and curiosity about building reusable skills that scale your impact.

  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder skills. You can distill complex findings for any audience up to C-level, and lead projects independently.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Familiarity with our stack (dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Python) and AI tooling such as Claude Code.

  • Hands-on financial crime, payments, or fraud analytics experience.

  • Experience working in start-ups or scale-ups.

Bonus Points

  • A crypto-native perspective and experience with on-chain and blockchain data (e.g. Dune, Flipside, Chainalysis).

  • Experience making data self-serve for non-analysts (e.g. semantic layers, metric stores).

title: Customer Care Data Analyst Intern
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

You will be an intern on the Customer Care team at Back Market supporting operations for the Customer Care, Shipping & Seller Quality teams.

We act as the data intelligence hub, combining analytical expertise with operational knowledge to drive customer satisfaction and business efficiency across Back Market's global operations.

  • Support decision making by conducting focused analyses on customer experience initiatives and learning how operational decisions impact business performance

  • Assist with data requests and reporting for our stakeholders, helping track key metrics (Contact Rate, On Time Delivery, Customer Satisfaction) and prepare performance reports

  • Maintain monitoring tools by updating Tableau dashboards and reports using SQL, Tableau, and Google Sheets to ensure data accuracy for the team.

  • Develop data analysis skills while working with experienced analysts to interpret customer satisfaction & shipping metrics,translating insights into actionable recommendations

  • Actively contribute to our data model, working with our analytics engineers to enable greater self-service across our stakeholder community

  • Develop the use of LLMs & AI to capture the voice of our customers & gain insights that drive better customer service

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You studying a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Management or STEM with specialization in data & analytics or equivalent

  • You have strong skills in data analytics, visualization and modeling, including experience with SQL & Gsheet ; ideally Tableau or DBT (Data Build Tool) too!

  • You possess a good balance of statistical/technical skills balanced with business acumen.

  • You have good communication skills and you are able to make your work accessible to a non-technical audience

  • You know how to work in autonomy

  • You like to do concrete things and you are not afraid to get your hands dirty

  • You are an amazing team player with whom it’s always a pleasure to work

  • You are fluent in English - French is a plus

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Full-time internship (35h/week - Monday to Friday)

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Campus Team Member/ the recruiter

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

title: Founding Data Analyst
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The Role

Dex runs on data. Our matching, our product decisions, our growth, our commercial bets all depend on understanding what's actually happening across the business, and right now that intelligence lives in too many places. This is a founding role to own the data foundation of Dex end to end: the data models underneath everything, the pipelines that connect our systems, and the data platform that the whole company (and our agents) builds on top of.

We use agents for a huge amount of our analytical work, which means the quality of our data layer is a force multiplier. Get it right and every person and every agent at Dex gets faster and sharper. You'll own how data is modelled, how it flows between our systems, and how internal teams self-serve on top of it, building on what's already driving the business rather than starting from a blank page.

As the first dedicated data hire, you'll set the standards and build the function out behind you as Dex grows. It's a chance to define how an AI-native company builds on its data from the ground up, in a market with a real dearth of well-built data foundations. We think there's a generational company to be built in this space, and we believe it's going to be Dex.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Core data modelling: Design and own the core data models that everything else depends on, making them clean, trusted and easy to build on.

  • Modelling at source: Work inside the product and engineering codebase to ensure data is captured and structured correctly from the start, before it ever reaches the warehouse.

  • Pipelines: Build and maintain the pipelines that connect our systems, so data flows through the business correctly and reliably.

  • Self-serve platform: Make the data platform genuinely self-serve, so product, growth, commercial and ops teams (and our agents) can answer their own questions without coming to you.

  • Agents as consumers: Treat agents as first-class consumers of the data layer, structuring data so they can do analytical work accurately and at scale.

  • Metrics that matter: Partner with the team on the metrics that matter, from acquisition and activation through to matching quality and commercial performance.

  • Answers, not just queries: Turn ambiguous business questions into the right data model, the right metric and a clear answer.

  • Standards: Set the standards for data quality, definitions and instrumentation across Dex.

 

What we’re looking for

  • You've built the data foundation for a consumer product or marketplace before, and you know what good looks like at scale.

  • You're an engineer and an analyst. You can model and pipe the data, and read what it's telling you about the business.

  • Comfortable reading existing code and finding your way through a codebase you didn't write. You can pick up how a system models and emits its data, and confidently make changes within it.

  • Fluent across a modern analytics stack (a cloud warehouse, a transformation layer, orchestration and BI), with views on what to use when. We're open to changing our current choices and want someone who can tell us where they're right and where they aren't.

  • Commercially and product minded. You care about the metric and the decision it drives, not just the query.

  • You think about the platform, not the one-off answer. You build things other people (and agents) can stand on.

  • Intelligent, ambitious, with strong judgement. A good person who's fun to work with and makes things happen without being asked.

    What We Offer

    • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

    • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

    • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

    • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

    • Gym membership & wellness benefits

    • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

    • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

    • MacBook Pro + team kit

    • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


    Interview process

    We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

    1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

    2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

    3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

    4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

    5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.
